title: After the Attacker Leaves: Benchmarking Carryover Attacks on LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.28425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern LLM agents persist state across sessions via two channels: long-lived memory files silently prepended to the system prompt, and scheduled tasks waking the agent without user input. A one-time indirect prompt injection committed to either channel can re-fire across sessions long after the attacker leaves, threats we term carryover attacks. Existing prompt-injection benchmarks evaluate attacks only in the session where malicious content is first observed, leaving the gate governing when and how often a planted payload later re-fires unmeasured. We present CarryoverBench: 12 personal-assistant scenarios and 101 attack tasks across three trigger channels: Instant, same-turn IPI; Autonomous, heartbeat-scheduled; and Latent, memory-resurfaced. A rule-based verifier scores planting and triggering as independent stages. Across five frontier models, planted payloads re-fire without measurable decay over five rounds; conditional on succes

translated_title: 攻击者离开之后：LLM智能体遗留攻击的基准测试
translated_abstract: 现代LLM智能体通过两个渠道跨会话持久化状态：一是被静默预置到系统提示词中的长效记忆文件，二是在没有用户输入的情况下唤醒智能体的定时任务。攻击者向任一渠道提交的一次性间接提示注入，可以在攻击者离开很久之后的后续会话中反复触发，我们将这类威胁称为“遗留攻击”。现有的提示注入基准仅在恶意内容首次被观察到的会话中评估攻击，而对于植入载荷后续何时以及以何种频率重新触发的门控机制却未加测量。我们提出了CarryoverBench：包含12个个人助理场景和101个攻击任务，覆盖三种触发渠道：即时——同一轮次的间接提示注入；自主——心跳定时调度；潜伏——记忆重新浮现。基于规则的验证器将“植入”与“触发”作为两个独立阶段进行评分。在五个前沿模型上的实验表明，被植入的载荷在五轮内持续重新触发且没有可测量的衰减；在……条件下（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了CarryoverBench——首个针对LLM智能体“遗留攻击”的基准，通过12个个人助理场景、101个攻击任务和三种触发渠道（即时、自主、潜伏），揭示植入的恶意提示注入载荷可在攻击者离开后跨会话反复触发且毫无衰减。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CarryoverBench, the first benchmark for carryover attacks on LLM agents, spanning 12 personal-assistant scenarios, 101 attack tasks, and three trigger channels, showing that planted prompt-injection payloads re-fire across sessions with no measurable decay long after the attacker leaves.
